de.title: IT-Englisch: deploy, rollout, outage und mehr
de.intro: Sechs Begriffe, die im IT-Alltag ständig fallen, mit deutscher Bedeutung und Beispielsatz.

cards.back: Software in einer Produktivumgebung installieren und in Betrieb nehmen. We deploy the new version on Friday.
schrittweise Einführung eines Produkts oder einer Technik. The rollout to all offices will take three weeks.
zeitweiser Ausfall, vor allem der Stromversorgung. The payment service had a two-hour outage.
etwas auf einen früheren Zustand zurücksetzen. The update caused errors, so we had to roll it back.
Frist, ein Termin, bis zu dem etwas fertig sein muss. The deadline for the report is Monday.
Person oder Organisation mit berechtigtem Interesse an einem Vorhaben. We update all stakeholders every week.

en.title: Tech English: deploy, rollout, outage and more
en.intro: Six terms that come up constantly in IT work, with meaning and an example sentence.

cards.back: to install and put software into a production environment. We deploy the new version on Friday.
the gradual introduction of a product or technology. The rollout to all offices will take three weeks.
a temporary suspension of operation, especially of power supply. The payment service had a two-hour outage.
to return something to an earlier state. The update caused errors, so we had to roll it back.
a time limit: the date by which something must be finished. The deadline for the report is Monday.
a person or organisation with a legitimate interest in a project or situation. We update all stakeholders every week.
